title: LiveAgentSessionHistory - Data API
description: This object is automatically created for each Chat session and stores information about changes made to the session. This object is available in API versions 28.0 and later.

DataType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
DataType.description: Data type of the field that was changed.

Field.description: The name of the field that was changed in a session record.

LiveAgentSessionId.description: ID of the session record that was changed.

NewValue.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

OldValue.description: The original value of the field that was changed.

usage: Use this object to identify changes to chat session records.
